name: Healthcare MIS / Diagnostics Booking Pack
description: Industry context for diagnostic lab booking MIS data — orders, customers, households, lab partners, and health packages.

vocabulary.booking: An order or transaction for a diagnostic test or health package
vocabulary.customer: Person who booked a test; identified by customer_id
vocabulary.household: Group of related customers sharing household_id (family/household bookings)
vocabulary.lab_partner: External lab vendor that fulfilled the booking
vocabulary.package: Product or service booked (e.g. Full Body Checkup, Diabetes Panel)
vocabulary.package_category: General vs Specialty classification of packages
vocabulary.payment_status: Paid or Pending — whether payment was collected
vocabulary.is_repeat_customer: Yes/No flag indicating a returning customer booking

kpis.name: monthly_revenue_trend
kpis.label: Monthly Revenue Trend
kpis.formula: sum(amount_inr) grouped by month(booking_date) where status = 'Completed'

kpis.name: bookings_by_city
kpis.label: Bookings by City
kpis.formula: count(booking_id) and sum(amount_inr) grouped by city

guardrails: Never expose phone or customer_name in aggregate outputs or dashboards
All data access must be read-only — no INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or DDL
Only reference columns that exist in the dataset schema
Prefer named KPI tools over ad-hoc SQL when a standard KPI applies
Limit ad-hoc query results to 200 rows maximum
